messages:
eli: opened a PR with an 'HSM migration cheat sheet' for on-prem customers. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4410. It's short, practical, and includes an example migration script.

anita: love the cheat-sheet idea. can you add a tiny matrix: installer version -> required softhsm version -> notes? customers often miss the softhsm minimum.

eli: yes, adding a 3-row table for 1.7/1.9/1.11. will note minimum softhsm 2.6 for v1.11.

doc-bot: PR #4410 created by eli — labels: docs,onprem,kms,cheatsheet. Preview: https://deploy-preview-4410--docs.redwood.ai/knb/onprem/hsm-cheatsheet

tom: include an example systemd flow and a dry-run helper. small bash snippet:
```bash
./migrate-hsm.sh --dry-run --src=/old/certs --dst=/etc/redwood/certs
# then: sudo systemctl restart redwood-agent
```

eli: adding that. also adding a short airgap section: where to put pkcs11 modules and how to set module_path in the installer YAML.

anita: also mention file perms: module must be readable by redwood user and owned by root:root, otherwise customers see segfaults.

infra-bot: deploy preview succeeded (status: success) — https://deploy-preview-4410--docs.redwood.ai/knb/onprem/hsm-cheatsheet

tom: can someone quick-review the wording about 'unsafe auto-copy' of certs? want to avoid implying we do key migration automatically.

eli: changed language to 'operator helper (opt-in) — not an automated migration'.

anita: small nit: change `module_path` to `kms.module_path` in the YAML example to match our config tree.

eli: updated. checklist in PR body: - draft cheat sheet - installer matrix - migrate-hsm.sh helper (dry-run) - perms note - airgap module placement - final review

doc-bot: Reminder — add an eval prompt set if you want to track post-migration regressions (link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/evals).
